idx.description: Four ordered zero-based atom indexes. Constructor builds three adjacent pairs internally; callers supply four atom indexes, not a pair matrix.

sigma.description: Actual PairEntropy constructor scalar; use the source radial-distribution convention.

r_ic.description: Actual PairEntropy constructor scalar; use the source radial-distribution convention.

r_oc.description: Actual PairEntropy constructor scalar; use the source radial-distribution convention.

dx.description: Actual PairEntropy constructor scalar; use the source radial-distribution convention.

beta.description: Actual Mininum1D beta; formula beta/log(sum(exp(beta/cv))). This is not the SoftMin lam parameter.

pdl.units: per-CV lower/upper bounds in the CV unit

MetaDGaussianBias.scale_rule: In this registered implementation scale.nonzero selects active dimensions; it does not multiply or normalize CV values. Do not apply PLUMED width conversions based on a guessed scaling role.
MetaDGaussianBias.sigma_rule: sigma and scale retain the FULL ordered CV-dimension vector; the implementation selects active indices internally. Widths have actual CV units and need explicit physical/pilot provenance. Canonical MetaD graph validation does not currently enforce this size; AIMatterLab must check it against plan.cv_size.

WTMetaDGaussianBias.scale_rule: In this registered implementation scale.nonzero selects active dimensions; it does not multiply or normalize CV values. Do not apply PLUMED width conversions based on a guessed scaling role.
WTMetaDGaussianBias.sigma_rule: sigma and scale retain the FULL ordered CV-dimension vector; the implementation selects active indices internally. Widths have actual CV units and need explicit physical/pilot provenance. Canonical MetaD graph validation does not currently enforce this size; AIMatterLab must check it against plan.cv_size.
WTMetaDGaussianBias.well_tempering: w_k=weight*exp(-bias_traj[k]/(8.617343e-5*temp*(bias_factor-1))); the encoded Boltzmann constant uses eV/K.

FFWTPDMetaDGaussianBias.scale_rule: In this registered implementation scale.nonzero selects active dimensions; it does not multiply or normalize CV values. Do not apply PLUMED width conversions based on a guessed scaling role.
FFWTPDMetaDGaussianBias.sigma_rule: sigma and scale retain the FULL ordered CV-dimension vector; the implementation selects active indices internally. Widths have actual CV units and need explicit physical/pilot provenance. Canonical MetaD graph validation does not currently enforce this size; AIMatterLab must check it against plan.cv_size.
FFWTPDMetaDGaussianBias.well_tempering: w_k=weight*exp(-bias_traj[k]/(8.617343e-5*temp*(bias_factor-1))); the encoded Boltzmann constant uses eV/K.
FFWTPDMetaDGaussianBias.periodic_rule: pdl reshapes to (cv_count,2); L=upper-lower, s0=mean(bounds), delta_wrap=delta-L*round((delta-s0)/L). Symmetric torsion bounds [-pi,pi] match the usual difference wrapping; an asymmetric interval must not be assumed equivalent without a numerical reference test.

Volume.units: Angstrom^3 / scale when input cell is in Angstrom
Volume.notes: Signed determinant, not absolute volume. scale must be nonzero. Constant-cell MD cannot explore this volume CV.
Volume.rank_scope: Source returns a zero-dimensional scalar. The registered renderer concatenates raw tensors; use an explicit identity reshape to preserve this scalar before Collect. output_size=1 alone does not prove rank one.

PairwiseDistanceMean.units: Angstrom when positions/cell are in Angstrom
PairwiseDistanceMean.notes: forward calls mean_nearest_neighbor_distance over all atoms; the separate static all-pair helper is not its forward. Not general PLUMED DISTANCE ATOMS=i,j.
PairwiseDistanceMean.rank_scope: Source returns a zero-dimensional scalar. The registered renderer concatenates raw tensors; use an explicit identity reshape to preserve this scalar before Collect. output_size=1 alone does not prove rank one.

PeriodicTorsion.formula: b1=MIC(rB-rA), b2=MIC(rC-rB), b3=MIC(rD-rC); n1=unit(b1 cross b2), n2=unit(b2 cross b3); phi=-atan2((n1 cross unit(b2)) dot n2, n1 dot n2)
PeriodicTorsion.notes: Four ordered zero-based atom indices; row-vector cell; normalizations include1e-12. Verify sign/domain against actual reference geometry before claiming PLUMED/ASE equivalence.
PeriodicTorsion.rank_scope: Source returns a zero-dimensional scalar. The registered renderer concatenates raw tensors; use an explicit identity reshape to preserve this scalar before Collect. output_size=1 alone does not prove rank one.

Torsion.formula: atan2((n1 x n2) dot unit(BC), n1 dot n2), n1=unit(AB x BC), n2=unit(BC x CD)
Torsion.index_rule: idx contains four ordered zero-based atom indexes; never truncate floating-point indexes to integers.
Torsion.pbc_rule: forward wraps individual selected positions into the primary cell using inv(cell).T before calculating bond vectors; this differs from PeriodicTorsion bond-wise row-cell MIC. simple_forward uses supplied coordinates without wrapping.
Torsion.singularities: Unclamped normalizations at collinear/zero bond geometries can be nonfinite. Require numerical reference tests before assuming sign, wrapping or PLUMED equivalence.
Torsion.rank_scope: Source returns a zero-dimensional scalar. The registered renderer concatenates raw tensors; use an explicit identity reshape to preserve this scalar before Collect. output_size=1 alone does not prove rank one.

ZoneSelect.reason: forward returns (match_pos, matching_indices), a dynamic tuple. The current graph value/collector/reducer contract expects a fixed-size Tensor; no automatic component selection or scalar reduction is valid. Library presence is not graph executability.

GroupVector.reason: forward returns (selected_pair_vectors, selected_edge_indices), a dynamic tuple, not a center-of-mass distance or scalar norm. The current graph value/collector/reducer contract expects a fixed-size Tensor; no automatic tuple selection or norm is implemented.

PairEntropy.units: eV/K with the source default kb and Angstrom inputs
PairEntropy.rank_scope: Source _s2 uses torch.trapezoid over one radial dimension and returns a zero-dimensional scalar. Add an explicit identity reshape before Collect; output_size=1 does not establish tensor rank.
PairEntropy.notes: The source uses int((r_oc-r_ic)/dx) linspace points, not an exact dx spacing. Require positive sigma, 0<r_ic<r_oc, at least two radial points, a positive-volume cell and numerically checked neighbor multiplicity before using this definition. This is the registered implementation, not an assumed PLUMED equivalent.
